visual_review.review_method: Viewed the approved project design before generation and opened the saved selected PNG with view_image after generation. No image alterations or crop previews.
visual_review.selection: generated-01.png retained as source candidate; not accepted for runtime
visual_review.identity: Mature angular face, curled heavy brown moustache, brown hair/sideburns, whole black bowler, brown overcoat, tan waistcoat, white shirt and dark tie are recognizable. The rendered portrait is not a pixel-identical enlargement of the reference.
visual_review.composition: One head-and-shoulders bust; both eyes clear and horizontally centered; entire crown and both brim tips visible. Opaque plain charcoal background, no lettering or UI.
visual_review.craftsmanship_palette: Sculpted miniature-like planes and detailed tactile cloth/felt, with warm brown/tan/black costume palette. Hex colors were prompt targets, not colorimetric compliance results.
limitations: Top empty margin approximately 7% rather than requested 17%; headgear is still completely visible.
Shoulders and lower chest continue into the side and bottom edges; the full bust silhouette is not isolated.
A hypothetical centered circle of diameter 0.90 times the image width appears to retain the head and hat, but cuts outer/lower shoulders. This is a visual estimate, not a rendered circular-mask test.
A tighter crop can cut the hat crown/brim; fine moustache, lapel and waistcoat detail may disappear at small sizes.
No actual circular crop, crop-coordinate acceptance, 32/40/64-pixel readability test, atlas conversion, runtime import or engine acceptance was performed.
visual_review.correction_decision: No actual head/headgear clipping or material identity failure observed; no correction call authorized by the limited correction rule was needed.
